"""Unit tests for the OpenAPI generation helper scripts in this directory.

These cover the pure, side-effect-free helpers used to translate FPP's
endpoint metadata into OpenAPI documents. They do not touch the filesystem
or invoke either script's ``main()``.
"""

import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, str(Path(__file__).parent))

import convert_endpoints as ce
import generate_openapi as ge


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# convert_endpoints.py
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_path_to_openapi_adds_leading_slash():
    assert ce.path_to_openapi("system/status") == "/system/status"


def test_path_to_openapi_converts_colon_params_to_braces():
    assert ce.path_to_openapi("channel/:id/set") == "/channel/{id}/set"


def test_extract_params_returns_path_param_specs():
    assert ce.extract_params("/channel/{id}") == [
        {"name": "id", "in": "path", "required": True, "schema": {"type": "string"}}
    ]


def test_extract_params_empty_when_no_params():
    assert ce.extract_params("/system/status") == []


def test_tag_from_endpoint_uses_first_segment():
    assert ce.tag_from_endpoint("system/status") == "system"


def test_yaml_scalar_primitives():
    assert ce.yaml_scalar(True) == "true"
    assert ce.yaml_scalar(False) == "false"
    assert ce.yaml_scalar(None) == "null"
    assert ce.yaml_scalar(5) == "5"
    assert ce.yaml_scalar("plain") == "plain"


def test_yaml_scalar_quotes_strings_with_special_chars():
    assert ce.yaml_scalar("a: b") == "'a: b'"


def test_needs_quoting():
    assert ce.needs_quoting("a:b") is True
    assert ce.needs_quoting("plain") is False


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# generate_openapi.py
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------

def test_extract_path_params_finds_all():
    assert ge.extract_path_params("/api/channel/{id}/x/{y}") == ["id", "y"]


def test_tag_from_path_skips_api_and_params():
    assert ge.tag_from_path("/api/system/status") == "system"


def test_tag_from_path_defaults_to_general():
    assert ge.tag_from_path("/api/{id}") == "general"


def test_parse_json_value_parses_json_and_passes_through_non_json():
    assert ge.parse_json_value("[1, 2]") == [1, 2]
    assert ge.parse_json_value("notjson") == "notjson"


def test_extract_mime_override_reads_bracketed_hint():
    mime, rest = ge.extract_mime_override(
        "[Content-Type: text/event-stream]\ndata", "text/plain"
    )
    assert mime == "text/event-stream"
    assert rest == "data"


def test_extract_mime_override_default_when_no_hint():
    assert ge.extract_mime_override("just text", "text/plain") == (
        "text/plain",
        "just text",
    )


def test_strip_stars_removes_leading_star_prefix():
    assert ge.strip_stars(" * hello\n * world") == "hello\nworld"


def test_parse_docblocks_extracts_route_metadata():
    src = (
        "/**\n"
        " * Get channel status.\n"
        " *\n"
        " * Returns the live channel data.\n"
        " * @route GET /api/channel/{id}/status\n"
        " * @param int limit max rows\n"
        ' * @body {"a": 1}\n'
        " * @response 200 ok\n"
        " * ```json\n"
        ' * {"ok": true}\n'
        " * ```\n"
        ' * @badge "Live" success\n'
        " */\n"
    )
    (ep,) = list(ge.parse_docblocks(src))

    assert ep["method"] == "get"
    assert ep["path"] == "/api/channel/{id}/status"
    assert ep["summary"] == "Get channel status."
    assert ep["description"] == "Returns the live channel data."
    assert ep["body_raw"] == '{"a": 1}'
    assert ep["responses"] == [(200, "ok", "json", '{"ok": true}')]
    assert ep["badges"] == [{"name": "Live", "color": ge.BADGE_COLORS["success"]}]
    # The path param {id} is excluded; only the query @param remains.
    assert [p["name"] for p in ep["params"]] == ["limit"]
    assert ep["params"][0]["schema"] == {"type": "integer"}


def test_parse_docblocks_ignores_blocks_without_route():
    assert list(ge.parse_docblocks("/** just a comment */")) == []
